items.title: Burrill Crohn interviewed by Monk Rowe, Woodstock, New York, January 3, 2012
items.q: And they had Nicholas Payton, David “Fathead” Newman, Don Byron.

ctx.x: He was a fashion photographer. Gjon Mili, he’s Hungarian. “The Conversation” is a great film. “Whatever Happened to Gilbert Grape,” Leonardo DiCaprio’s first film and as far as I’m concerned by far his best film. And I’m going to not remember — Robert Altman’s “Jazz 34,” which is the outtakes, the outtakes of Kansas City. You know in Kansas City there’s the jazz scene there, but he shot, there’s something called “Kansas City 34.” And it’s a seventy minute film and it starts early in the day, I mean late in the…
